translations.literal: Subordinates followed the capital precedent.
translations.idiomatic: Their subordinates followed capital rules.

sentences.zh: 德州等處城守尉、協領，派大臣往考，會同察覈其屬，註考以聞。

translations.literal: Garrison commandants and assistant commandants at Dezhou and elsewhere were examined by dispatched ministers, who jointly inspected their subordinates, noted evaluations, and reported.
translations.idiomatic: Garrison commandants and assistant commandants at Dezhou and elsewhere were examined by dispatched ministers who jointly reviewed subordinates and reported evaluations.

sentences.zh: 雍正元年，命平等官守備以上，督、撫、提、鎮註考。

translations.literal: In the first year of Yongzheng, average officials from garrison commanders upward were ordered evaluated by governors-general, governors, provincial commanders, and regional commanders.
translations.idiomatic: In Yongzheng 1 (1723), average officials from garrison commander rank upward were evaluated by governors and military commanders.

sentences.zh: 其冬，詔曰：「初次考選軍政，有出兵效力、年老俸深、尚能坐理者，留任。

translations.literal: That winter an edict said: "At the first military inspection selection, those who served in campaigns, were old with deep salary tenure, and could still manage affairs were retained.
translations.idiomatic: That winter an edict stated: "At the first military inspection, veterans with long service who could still manage affairs were retained.

sentences.zh: 不宜留任者，另奏加恩。

translations.literal: Those unsuitable for retention were separately memorialized for special grace.
translations.idiomatic: Those unsuitable for retention were separately memorialized for special grace.

sentences.zh: 或雖未效力行間，而供職年久者，亦留心驗看。

translations.literal: Or though they had not served in campaigns, if their tenure was long, they should also be carefully examined."
translations.idiomatic: Even those without campaign service but with long tenure were to be carefully examined."

sentences.zh: 」此則垂念資勞，特頒寬典，非常例也。

translations.literal: This showed concern for senior merit and labor, a specially issued lenient measure—not ordinary precedent.
translations.idiomatic: This showed concern for long service—a special leniency, not ordinary precedent.

sentences.zh: 二年，諭各省所保副、參、游擊，輪流引見，察其人材弓馬，督、撫、提、鎮以其操守訓練，分別等第密陳。

translations.literal: In the second year it was ordered that recommended brigade generals, regimental colonels, and battalion commanders in the provinces be presented in rotation, their talent and horsemanship inspected, and governors and commanders secretly memorialize grades according to integrity and training.
translations.idiomatic: In Yongzheng 2 (1724) recommended brigade generals, regimental colonels, and battalion commanders were presented in rotation; governors and commanders secretly reported grades based on integrity, training, and horsemanship.

sentences.zh: 六年，山西太原總兵官袁立松疏陳平垣營守備梁玉廉潔敏練，以年老入參劾。

translations.literal: In the sixth year, Taiyuan regional commander Yuan Lisong of Shanxi memorialized that Pingyuan garrison commander Liang Yulian was honest, keen, and skilled, yet was impeached on account of age.
translations.idiomatic: In Yongzheng 6 (1728), Regional Commander Yuan Lisong of Taiyuan memorialized that Garrison Commander Liang Yulian of Pingyuan was honest, capable, and skilled, yet was impeached for age.

sentences.zh: 帝以諳練才不可多得，命酌量以游擊題補，尤殊恩也。

translations.literal: The emperor held that seasoned talent was hard to find and ordered him considered for appointment as battalion commander—a special grace indeed.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor ruled that seasoned talent was rare and ordered him considered for battalion commander—a special grace.

sentences.zh: 是年定卓異官原任有貪酷不法，或升調他省，別犯贓罪，原舉長官，分別處分。

translations.literal: That year it was fixed that when outstanding officials in their original posts were greedy, cruel, and lawless, or after transfer to another province separately committed corruption, the original recommending superior would be punished according to circumstances.
translations.idiomatic: That year penalties were set for recommenders when outstanding officials proved corrupt, including offenses committed after transfer to another province.

sentences.zh: 乾隆二年，部議出兵效力人員，年老休致，令子弟一人入伍食糧，無子弟亦給守糧養贍。

translations.literal: In the second year of Qianlong the ministry deliberated that campaign veterans who retired on age should have one son enter the ranks for rations; if no son, guard-ration support was given.
translations.idiomatic: In Qianlong 2 (1737) the Board ruled that campaign veterans retiring on age could have one son enter the ranks for rations, or receive guard-ration support if they had no son.

sentences.zh: 從之。

translations.literal: This was approved.
translations.idiomatic: The proposal was approved.

sentences.zh: 時直省保題員弁，類以明白勤敏、才堪辦事列上選。

translations.literal: At that time in the provinces, recommended officers were generally listed for top selection as clear, diligent, keen, and capable of handling affairs.
translations.idiomatic: Provincial nominations then typically cited clarity, diligence, and administrative competence for top selection.

sentences.zh: 十一年，諭嗣後保題，務重弓馬漢仗。

translations.literal: In the eleventh year an edict ordered that henceforth nominations must emphasize archery, horsemanship, and Chinese weapons.
translations.idiomatic: In Qianlong 11 (1746) an edict required future nominations to emphasize archery, horsemanship, and weapons drill.

sentences.zh: 十五年，以各省所保總兵官鮮當意，諭曰：「年滿千總一項，類多猥瑣。

translations.literal: In the fifteenth year, because recommended regional commanders in the provinces rarely pleased the emperor, an edict said: "The category of battalion commanders completing tenure is mostly petty and trivial.
translations.idiomatic: In Qianlong 15 (1750), because nominated regional commanders rarely satisfied the emperor, an edict declared: "Battalion commanders completing tenure are mostly petty and trivial.

sentences.zh: 國家擢用武職，營伍為正途，拔補將弁，必選之若輩。

translations.literal: The state promotes military officers; the camps are the proper path; selecting and filling generals and officers must choose from such men.
translations.idiomatic: The state promotes military officers through the camps—the proper path—and must select generals and officers from among them.

sentences.zh: 緣次而升，皆自年滿千總始。

translations.literal: Promotion by steps all begins from battalion commanders completing tenure.
translations.idiomatic: Stepwise promotion all begins with battalion commanders completing tenure.

sentences.zh: 折衝禦侮之用，豫籌於昇平無事之日，不可視為緩圖。

translations.literal: The use of repelling enemies and defending insult must be prepared in days of peace and ease; it cannot be treated as a matter to defer."
translations.idiomatic: Defense against enemies must be prepared in peacetime and cannot be deferred."

sentences.zh: 」二十四年，以大臣自陳例既罷，敕兵部于軍政年，將在京都統、副都統，在外駐防將軍、都統、副都統，各省提督、總兵官，分別三本，條舉事實候鑒裁，以重考績。

translations.literal: In the twenty-fourth year, because the grand-minister self-assessment precedent had been abolished, the Board of War was ordered that in military inspection years, capital lieutenant-generals and deputy lieutenant-generals, garrison generals, commandants, and deputy commandants in the provinces, and provincial and regional commanders should each submit three memorials listing facts for imperial judgment, to strengthen performance evaluation.
translations.idiomatic: In Qianlong 24 (1759), with ministerial self-assessment abolished, the Board of War ordered capital and provincial commanders to submit three memorials listing facts during military inspection years, strengthening performance review.

sentences.zh: 四十二年，定衛、所綠營武職薦舉卓異尚未升轉，再遇軍政列平等者，將上次卓異註銷。

translations.literal: In the forty-second year it was fixed that Green Standard military officials in guards and posts recommended as outstanding but not yet promoted, if at the next military inspection listed as average, had the previous outstanding nomination cancelled.
translations.idiomatic: In Qianlong 42 (1777), Green Standard officers nominated as outstanding but not yet promoted had that nomination cancelled if rated average at the next military inspection.

sentences.zh: 嘉慶四年，定侍衛軍政考試，向例軍政年不許告病乞休，以杜規避。

translations.literal: In the fourth year of Jiaqing, guard military inspection examinations were fixed; by precedent illness retirement was not permitted in inspection years, to prevent evasion.
translations.idiomatic: In Jiaqing 4 (1799), guard military inspections were regulated; illness retirement was forbidden in inspection years to prevent evasion.

sentences.zh: 八年，申諭查閱營伍年分，事關考覈，照軍政例，不得告病、乞休。

translations.literal: In the eighth year it was reiterated that in years of camp inspection, which concerned evaluation, following military inspection precedent, illness retirement was not permitted.
translations.idiomatic: In Jiaqing 8 (1803) it was reiterated that illness retirement was forbidden in camp-inspection years, as in military inspection years.

sentences.zh: 咸、同軍興，百度稍弛，軍政大典，相沿不廢。

translations.literal: During the Xianfeng and Tongzhi military campaigns, many regulations grew lax, yet the great military inspection ritual continued without abolition.
translations.idiomatic: During the Xianfeng and Tongzhi wars many regulations lapsed, yet the great military inspection continued.

sentences.zh: 咸豐二年，黑龍江將軍英隆以俄兵窺伺，派將弁扼守要隘，疏請本年軍政展限舉行。

translations.literal: In the second year of Xianfeng, Heilongjiang General Yinglong, because Russian troops were watching, dispatched officers to hold key passes and memorialized requesting extension of that year's military inspection.
translations.idiomatic: In Xianfeng 2 (1852), Heilongjiang General Yinglong, facing Russian probing, dispatched officers to key passes and requested postponing that year's military inspection.

sentences.zh: 不允。

translations.literal: This was not approved.
translations.idiomatic: The request was denied.

sentences.zh: 嗣湖廣總督程矞采等以軍務未竣，疏請展限，令凱撤後再行補考。

translations.literal: Later Huguang Governor-General Cheng Yucai and others, because military affairs were unfinished, memorialized requesting extension, ordering supplementary examination after victory and withdrawal.
translations.idiomatic: Later Huguang Governor-General Cheng Yucai and others, citing unfinished military affairs, requested extension and supplementary examination after victory.

sentences.zh: 並諭年老力衰者，隨時參辦。

translations.literal: It was also ordered that the aged and weak might be impeached at any time.
translations.idiomatic: Aged and weak officers could also be impeached at any time.

sentences.zh: 沿及德宗，雖加意振飭，勢成弩末，展限之舉，史不絕書。

translations.literal: Down to the Guangxu Emperor, though he strove to revive and rectify, momentum was like an arrow at the end of its flight; extensions were recorded endlessly in history.
translations.idiomatic: Under the Guangxu Emperor, despite efforts at revival, momentum failed; extensions were endlessly recorded.

sentences.zh: 光緒十四年，編定北洋海軍，由海軍衙門司黜陟。

translations.literal: In the fourteenth year of Guangxu the Beiyang Navy was organized, with promotion and demotion overseen by the Naval Affairs Yamen.
translations.idiomatic: In Guangxu 14 (1888) the Beiyang Navy was organized, with promotions overseen by the Naval Affairs Yamen.

sentences.zh: 甲午以後，力鑒覆轍，裁綠營，練新軍，別訂考覈章程。

translations.literal: After the Jiawu year, taking hard lesson from repeated failure, the Green Standard Army was cut, new armies drilled, and separate evaluation regulations drawn up.
translations.idiomatic: After the Sino-Japanese War of 1894–95, learning from defeat, the Green Standard Army was cut, new armies trained, and separate evaluation regulations drafted.

sentences.zh: 三十二年，改兵部為陸軍部，其考覈隸軍衡司。

translations.literal: In the thirty-second year the Board of War was changed to the Ministry of the Army; evaluation fell under the Department of Military Standards.
translations.idiomatic: In Guangxu 32 (1906) the Board of War became the Ministry of the Army, with evaluation under the Department of Military Standards.

sentences.zh: 宣統二年，設海軍部，其考覈隸軍制司。

translations.literal: In the second year of Xuantong the Ministry of the Navy was established; evaluation fell under the Department of Military Organization.
translations.idiomatic: In Xuantong 2 (1910) the Ministry of the Navy was established, with evaluation under the Department of Military Organization.

sentences.zh: 朝廷銳意革新，軍紀宜可少振。

translations.literal: The court was keen to innovate; military discipline ought to have been somewhat revived.
translations.idiomatic: The court was keen to reform; military discipline ought to have improved somewhat.

sentences.zh: 無如積習已深，時艱日棘，卒歸罔濟雲。

translations.literal: Yet entrenched habits were already deep, the times grew daily more difficult, and in the end it came to naught.
translations.idiomatic: Yet entrenched habits ran deep, the times grew harder daily, and in the end nothing availed.
